description: Renovate proposes updates as pull requests and merges none of them.
It covers the GitHub Actions in .github/workflows (pinned to commit SHAs with the version in a comment) and the development tools in the dev dependency group of pyproject.toml, together with uv.lock.
It also covers the uv_build build backend in [build-system] requires. uv.lock does not hold it, so only a release outside its range is proposed, as a new range.
The Python versions and the uv version that CI uses, and requires-python, are chosen by hand.

A release becomes an update 7 days after it is published. For a GitHub Action, that is when its GitHub Release was published; a version tagged without a GitHub Release counts from its commit or tag date, which can be earlier than the tag.

packageRules.description: The inputs given to actions (setup-uv's version and python-version) are chosen by hand.
The supported Python versions (requires-python) are chosen by hand.
